finding.headline: "Lost Vaccination Card / Missed Dose Catch-Up"
finding.problem: "I can't find the card and the 14-week date passed. Will my baby be unprotected? The clinic just looked at me."

finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.
